updates.title: Establishment of Class E Airspace; Columbus, TX
updates.summary: This action proposes to establish Class E airspace at Columbus Community Hospital Heliport, Columbus, TX. The FAA is proposing this action to support new instrument procedures and instrument flight rule (IFR) operations.

updates.title: Amendment of Class E Airspace; Del Rio, TX
updates.summary: This action amends the Class E airspace at Del Rio, TX. This action is the result of a biennial review of the airspace associated with Laughlin Air Force Base (AFB), Del Rio, TX. This proposal also updates the name and geographic coordinates of Laughlin AFB to coincide with the FAA's aeronautical database. updates.title: Connect America Fund; A National Broadband Plan for Our Future High-Cost Universal Support, Reforming the High-Cost Program for an All-IP Future, Safeguarding Universal Service Funding Through Effective Applicant Vetting
updates.summary: In this document, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC or Commission) initiates a rulemaking to establish a vetting process for applicants for, and other recipients of, certain new funding awards of high-cost Universal Service Fund (USF) support.

updates.title: Amendment of Class D and E Airspace and Removal of Class E Airspace Over Lebanon, NH
updates.summary: This action proposes to amend Class D and Class E airspace over Lebanon, NH. This action would increase the lateral dimensions of the Lebanon, NH, Class D airspace to appropriately contain Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) operations at the Lebanon Municipal Airport. updates.title: Horse Protection Amendments; Extension of Postponement of Regulations
updates.summary: On May 8, 2024, we published a final rule amending the horse protection regulations. updates.title: Certain Transformers and Components Thereof; Notice of a Commission Determination Not To Review an Initial Determination Granting Joint Motion To Terminate the Investigation Based on Settlement; Termination of the Investigation in Its Entirety
updates.summary: Notice is hereby given that the U.S. International Trade Commission has determined not to review the presiding administrative law judge's ("ALJ") initial determination ("ID") (Order No. 10), granting a joint motion to terminate the investigation based on settlement. The investigation is terminated in its entirety.

updates.title: Magnesia Carbon Bricks From China and Mexico; Scheduling of Expedited Five-Year Reviews
